bounds.collisionImplications: The primary hull, pivot and calibration are unchanged. Removing the navigation housings reduces full width by 0.3973 m to 836.2584 m; full length remains 1803.2965 m. Full height remains 503.1105 m, including ventral armament. Use hull-only geometry for hull collision and mounted-gun geometry separately. The six lateral apertures remain open; forward launch aprons and fitted underside details belong to the hull. Window banks are flush surface detail.

verification.criticalVisualReview: All ten navigation-window housings are absent, with denser tiny panes on both sides, command decks and the bow; full-footprint checks keep rows clear of hangars and sensors. Measured texture scale and all paint surfaces passed matched before/after and close views with metric rulers. Passed matched neutral/textured views, both sides, all hangar inner edges from high/low angles, underside plating and thermal cassettes, and dorsal/ventral articulated guns. Native renders from above and below match the final GLB.
verification.retainedTextureScope: The four remaining original runtime images; armor maps are intentionally replaced by the physical-scale PBR set.

runtimeIntegration.instruction: Use measured runtime-handoff.json, retain the named pivots and avoid adding duplicate weapons. Hull-only and armament exports are supplied separately. Gameplay balance is unchanged.
runtimeIntegration.limits: PDCs tested at plus/minus 35 degrees around a 45 degree outboard rest pose; batteries at plus/minus 55 degrees; elevation 0–40 degrees.
runtimeIntegration.paintNote: The 128 m repeat PBR maps and physical UVs are baked into the final hull and armament exports. Do not restore the old large hatch atlas on these meshes.
runtimeOptions: Combine hull-only.glb and armament.glb under the same carrier parent with identical calibration/yaw. The armament export already contains all measured mount transforms.
Use candidate.glb once, retain the named yaw/pitch nodes, and avoid duplicate factory guns.

windowGeometryNote: Small individual panes are baked on narrow closed window banks conformed to the existing hull. No extra runtime attachments or code are needed.
